title: Update Floor Setting
description: Updates a floor setting for a given project and location.

objective.narrative: A floor setting defines the baseline security posture for AI models within a project or organization, specifying default filtering rules and enforcement actions. This sample demonstrates how to update the enforcement status and AI Platform specific settings of an existing floor setting.
